processSteps.operationMethod: Receive fresh chicory root, remove rotten/deformed tubers
Wash and peel in ultrasonic cleaner; expanded skin rubs against fish-scale wall under ultrasonic water flow
Feed peeled tubers into three-stage crusher for primary crushing
Mash the crushed tubers with hammer-type masher
Mix mashed tubers with water and stir rapidly into slurry
Ultrasonic treatment of slurry to disrupt cell walls and release inulin
Heat and pressurize slurry, let stand, take supernatant as crude extract
Hot-water extraction of inulin, remove coarse residue
Concentrate crude extract under vacuum
Filter concentrated extract through membrane to remove protein and cellulose
Heat filtered extract and stir to flocculate
Centrifuge to remove residual precipitate
Remove pigments by activated carbon adsorption
Centrifuge to remove activated carbon
Pass through anion then cation exchange resin to remove ions
Stir deionized inulin solution and filter through membrane again
Pour fine inulin solution into tank for alcohol precipitation; collect precipitates of different DP
processSteps.parameters: Alcohol precipitation; collect by degree of polymerization

processSteps.operationMethod: Dry alcohol-precipitated inulin in dryer
Inspect finished inulin for metal foreign objects
Fill and pack finished inulin
Store finished product in warehouse

hazardBio.control: 后续通过有效的高温处理环节消除（如高温干燥）；如果接收区域和其他原料共用需彻底消毒设备|||Eliminated by subsequent effective high-temperature processing (e.g., high-temperature drying); thoroughly disinfect equipment if the receiving area is shared with other raw materials
hazardBio.detail: 菊芋原料常见的生物危害有真菌（霉菌）、害虫（蛴螬、地老虎，蚜虫）、细菌（大肠杆菌、鞘氨醇菌、假单胞菌、产碱杆菌、葡萄球菌、大肠杆菌和芽孢杆菌），后续它们可以通过有效的高温处理环节被消除（例如高温干燥）。如果接收区域和其他原料共用，且后续无法对设备进行彻底消毒，那就有交叉污染的风险。|||Common biological hazards in chicory root raw materials include fungi (molds), pests (white grubs, cutworms, aphids) and bacteria (E. coli, Sphingomonas, Pseudomonas, Alcaligenes, Staphylococcus, E. coli and Bacillus). They can be eliminated by effective subsequent high-temperature processing (e.g., high-temperature drying). If the receiving area is shared with other raw materials and equipment cannot be thoroughly disinfected, there is a risk of cross-contamination.

hazardBio.control: 查验第三方检测报告确保符合GB 1886.255-2016或GB 1886.363-2022食用级活性炭要求；干燥存储|||Verify third-party test reports per GB 1886.255-2016 or GB 1886.363-2022 food-grade activated carbon requirements; store in a dry place
hazardBio.detail: 活性炭是多孔结构吸附大量有机物，在潮湿环境极易滋生细菌和霉菌；肉毒素是当革兰氏阴性菌在活性炭上繁殖并死亡裂解后产生的，在高温下也无法杀死。活性炭入厂时，必须查验并核对其第三方检测报告确保其符合GB 1886.255-2016 或GB 1886.363-2022中关于食用级活性炭的要求，否则后续操作无法去除这些危害。|||Activated carbon has a porous structure that adsorbs large amounts of organic matter and easily harbors bacteria and mold in humid environments; botulinum toxin is produced when Gram-negative bacteria grow and lyse on activated carbon and cannot be destroyed even at high temperatures. At receiving, third-party test reports must be verified per GB 1886.255-2016 or GB 1886.363-2022 food-grade activated carbon requirements; otherwise subsequent operations cannot remove these hazards.

hazardChem.control: 原料必须由实施良好农业规范（GAP）、信誉良好的供应商提供，需提供分析证书和相关检测报告|||Raw materials must be sourced from reputable suppliers implementing Good Agricultural Practices (GAP), with analysis certificates and relevant test reports
hazardChem.detail: 如果原料中的农药残留和金属残留不满足控制标准（如GB 2763农药残留、GB 2762重金属限量等）有机磷类农药≤0.01mg/kg拟除虫菊酯类≤0.05mg/kg，那么后续的操作是无法消除这些残留危害的，所以原料必须由实施良好农业规范（GAP）、信誉良好的供应商提供，同时还需提供分析证书和相关检测报告。|||If pesticide and heavy metal residues in raw materials fail to meet control standards (e.g., GB 2763 pesticide residues, GB 2762 heavy metal limits; organophosphates ≤0.01 mg/kg, pyrethroids ≤0.05 mg/kg), subsequent operations cannot eliminate these residues. Therefore, raw materials must be sourced from reputable GAP-implementing suppliers with analysis certificates and test reports.

hazardChem.control: 入厂时查验第三方检测报告确保符合GB 1886.255-2016或GB 1886.363-2022食用级活性炭要求|||Verify third-party test reports at receiving per GB 1886.255-2016 or GB 1886.363-2022 food-grade activated carbon requirements
hazardChem.detail: 活性炭的生产可能含有重金属残留（如铅、砷）、工艺副产物（高级芳香烃、氰化物）残留等危害，活性炭入厂时，必须查验并核对其第三方检测报告确保其符合GB 1886.255-2016 或GB 1886.363-2022中关于食用级活性炭的要求，否则后续操作无法去除这些危害。|||Activated carbon production may leave heavy metal residues (e.g., lead, arsenic) and process by-products (higher aromatic hydrocarbons, cyanides). At receiving, third-party test reports must be verified per GB 1886.255-2016 or GB 1886.363-2022; otherwise subsequent operations cannot remove these hazards.

hazardPhys.control: 后续加工可通过过滤等技术去除|||Removed by subsequent processing techniques such as filtration
hazardPhys.detail: 在接收过程中，会检查灰尘、玻璃碎片、塑料碎片、毛发、土壤颗粒物以及昆虫尸体等，并且后续加工有一定的技术去除他们（例如过滤）。|||During receiving, dust, glass fragments, plastic pieces, hair, soil particles and insect remains are inspected and can be removed by subsequent processing techniques such as filtration.

hazardPhys.control: 后续通过过滤操作有效去除|||Effectively removed by subsequent filtration
hazardPhys.detail: 活性炭本身可能会混入其他颗粒杂质，例如包装破损可能引入塑料等异物，不过后续能通过过滤操作有效去除。|||Activated carbon itself may contain granular impurities; for example, damaged packaging may introduce plastic and other foreign matter, which can be effectively removed by subsequent filtration.

pd_rawProps: Product: Food-grade Inulin. Category: Water-soluble dietary fibre food ingredient. Main component: Inulin polysaccharide. Appearance: White fine powder, soluble in water. Stable at normal storage temperature; low glycaemic index. Complies with national food safety standards.
pd_rawSupply: Raw material: Fresh chicory root tuber; rich in inulin, carbohydrate, moisture. Packaging materials: Food-grade aluminium composite film and PE plastic bags. The packaging is non-toxic, moisture-proof, stable under normal temperature and avoids migration of harmful substances.
pd_rawUsage: chicory root is purchased from qualified planting bases in Gansu Province. Food-grade packaging materials are sourced from certified food packaging manufacturers. Raw materials are transported in covered vehicles and stored in ventilated, dry warehouses. Packaging materials are kept away from moisture and contamination before use.
pd_productProps: Raw material batches shall be inspected for pesticides, heavy metals and microbial indicators before acceptance. Random sampling inspection is adopted. Unqualified raw materials will be rejected. Packaging materials must provide qualification certificates; damaged packages are prohibited from production.
pd_productProcess: Raw material cleaning and sorting → Crushing and homogenisation → Heating & pressurised extraction → Vacuum concentration → Multi-stage membrane filtration → Activated carbon decolourisation → Ion exchange desalination → Ethanol precipitation → Hot air drying → Finished product packaging.
pd_productStorage: Finished products are sealed in food-grade aluminium foil packages. Store in cool, dry, dark environment (temperature ≤25℃). Avoid humidity and direct sunlight during transportation. Covered dry vehicles are used for delivery to prevent package breakage and moisture absorption.
pd_productSales: Products are sold to food manufacturers and end consumers via domestic and international channels. Product labels include product name, ingredients, shelf life, storage conditions, manufacturer information and allergen statements, complying with food labelling regulations.
iu_consumerExpect: Consumers expect the inulin powder to be pure, free of hazardous contaminants, stable in quality, with good water solubility and neutral flavour. The product should meet food safety standards and deliver expected prebiotic benefits for intestinal health.
iu_intendedUse: Intended use: Food raw material and water-soluble dietary fibre supplement. Storage: Sealed, kept in cool, dry and dark environment (≤25°C), protected from moisture. Shelf life: 24 months in intact original packaging.
iu_consumptionMethod: Industrial application: Added into dairy, baked goods and beverages. Direct consumption: Dissolve the powder in warm water for daily drinking.
iu_targetCustomer: Food processing manufacturers; general adult consumers who pay attention to gastrointestinal health.
iu_vulnerableGroups: Elderly people and pregnant women can take moderate doses. Infants require reduced intake. Individuals with chicory root allergy shall not consume this product.
iu_unintendedUse: Excessive consumption resulting in flatulence and abdominal discomfort; use of damp & deteriorated products; overfeeding infants; improper application for non-food purposes.
_hazardStepFingerprint: Fresh chicory root,Ultrasonic cleaning and peeling,Crushing pretreatment,Fine grinding,Homogenization,Ultrasound disruption,Precipitation,Hot-water extraction,Vacuum concentration,Membrane filtration,Flocculation,Centrifugal separation,Activated carbon decolorization,Centrifugal carbon removal,Resin deionization,Secondary membrane filtration,Alcohol precipitation,Drying,Metal detection,Packaging,Storage

bio.control: 后续通过有效的高温处理环节消除（如高温干燥）；如果接收区域和其他原料共用需彻底消毒设备|||Eliminated by subsequent effective high-temperature processing (e.g., high-temperature drying); thoroughly disinfect equipment if the receiving area is shared with other raw materials
bio.detail: 菊芋原料常见的生物危害有真菌（霉菌）、害虫（蛴螬、地老虎，蚜虫）、细菌（大肠杆菌、鞘氨醇菌、假单胞菌、产碱杆菌、葡萄球菌、大肠杆菌和芽孢杆菌），后续它们可以通过有效的高温处理环节被消除（例如高温干燥）。如果接收区域和其他原料共用，且后续无法对设备进行彻底消毒，那就有交叉污染的风险。|||Common biological hazards in chicory root raw materials include fungi (molds), pests (white grubs, cutworms, aphids) and bacteria (E. coli, Sphingomonas, Pseudomonas, Alcaligenes, Staphylococcus, E. coli and Bacillus). They can be eliminated by effective subsequent high-temperature processing (e.g., high-temperature drying). If the receiving area is shared with other raw materials and equipment cannot be thoroughly disinfected, there is a risk of cross-contamination.

chem.control: 原料必须由实施良好农业规范（GAP）、信誉良好的供应商提供，需提供分析证书和相关检测报告|||Raw materials must be sourced from reputable suppliers implementing Good Agricultural Practices (GAP), with analysis certificates and relevant test reports
chem.detail: 如果原料中的农药残留和金属残留不满足控制标准（如GB 2763农药残留、GB 2762重金属限量等）有机磷类农药≤0.01mg/kg拟除虫菊酯类≤0.05mg/kg，那么后续的操作是无法消除这些残留危害的，所以原料必须由实施良好农业规范（GAP）、信誉良好的供应商提供，同时还需提供分析证书和相关检测报告。|||If pesticide and heavy metal residues in raw materials fail to meet control standards (e.g., GB 2763 pesticide residues, GB 2762 heavy metal limits; organophosphates ≤0.01 mg/kg, pyrethroids ≤0.05 mg/kg), subsequent operations cannot eliminate these residues. Therefore, raw materials must be sourced from reputable GAP-implementing suppliers with analysis certificates and test reports.

phys.control: 后续加工可通过过滤等技术去除|||Removed by subsequent processing techniques such as filtration
phys.detail: 在接收过程中，会检查灰尘、玻璃碎片、塑料碎片、毛发、土壤颗粒物以及昆虫尸体等，并且后续加工有一定的技术去除他们（例如过滤）。|||During receiving, dust, glass fragments, plastic pieces, hair, soil particles and insect remains are inspected and can be removed by subsequent processing techniques such as filtration.

bio.control: 查验第三方检测报告确保符合GB 1886.255-2016或GB 1886.363-2022食用级活性炭要求；干燥存储|||Verify third-party test reports per GB 1886.255-2016 or GB 1886.363-2022 food-grade activated carbon requirements; store in a dry place
bio.detail: 活性炭是多孔结构吸附大量有机物，在潮湿环境极易滋生细菌和霉菌；肉毒素是当革兰氏阴性菌在活性炭上繁殖并死亡裂解后产生的，在高温下也无法杀死。活性炭入厂时，必须查验并核对其第三方检测报告确保其符合GB 1886.255-2016 或GB 1886.363-2022中关于食用级活性炭的要求，否则后续操作无法去除这些危害。|||Activated carbon has a porous structure that adsorbs large amounts of organic matter and easily harbors bacteria and mold in humid environments; botulinum toxin is produced when Gram-negative bacteria grow and lyse on activated carbon and cannot be destroyed even at high temperatures. At receiving, third-party test reports must be verified per GB 1886.255-2016 or GB 1886.363-2022 food-grade activated carbon requirements; otherwise subsequent operations cannot remove these hazards.

chem.control: 入厂时查验第三方检测报告确保符合GB 1886.255-2016或GB 1886.363-2022食用级活性炭要求|||Verify third-party test reports at receiving per GB 1886.255-2016 or GB 1886.363-2022 food-grade activated carbon requirements
chem.detail: 活性炭的生产可能含有重金属残留（如铅、砷）、工艺副产物（高级芳香烃、氰化物）残留等危害，活性炭入厂时，必须查验并核对其第三方检测报告确保其符合GB 1886.255-2016 或GB 1886.363-2022中关于食用级活性炭的要求，否则后续操作无法去除这些危害。|||Activated carbon production may leave heavy metal residues (e.g., lead, arsenic) and process by-products (higher aromatic hydrocarbons, cyanides). At receiving, third-party test reports must be verified per GB 1886.255-2016 or GB 1886.363-2022; otherwise subsequent operations cannot remove these hazards.

phys.control: 后续通过过滤操作有效去除|||Effectively removed by subsequent filtration
phys.detail: 活性炭本身可能会混入其他颗粒杂质，例如包装破损可能引入塑料等异物，不过后续能通过过滤操作有效去除。|||Activated carbon itself may contain granular impurities; for example, damaged packaging may introduce plastic and other foreign matter, which can be effectively removed by subsequent filtration.
